gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-taviraj: Chunky, confident lettering with tubing-like strokes up top. Aaargh is best at announcing itself in a single strong gauge, while Taviraj does its finest work in the restrained difference between its stems and joining strokes.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-uchen: Round, commanding letters with walls that never swell. Aaargh lays down its uniform bowls like pipework, and Uchen follows with dignified, gently contrasted strokes that keep the page from feeling mechanical.
